Fixing the onSuccess handler to handle the session correctly after signup:


```typescriptreact
'use client'

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { signUp, useSession } from '@/lib/auth-client'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react'
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast'
import { getRedirectContext, type AuthFlow } from '@/lib/auth-redirect'
import { getRedirectPath, getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain, validateRedirectUrl } from '@/lib/auth-utils'

export function SignUpForm() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { data: session } = useSession()
  const { toast } = useToast()
  const [name, setName] = useState('')
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('')
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false)
  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [justSignedUp, setJustSignedUp] = useState(false)

  // Redirect if already signed in (use useEffect to avoid render-time navigation)
  // BUT: Don't redirect if we just signed up (let onSuccess handle it)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (session?.user?.id && !justSignedUp) {
      // Check if we're coming from a successful provider signup
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
      const signupFlow = urlParams.get('flow') as AuthFlow | null

      // If this is a provider signup flow, check for subdomain redirect
      if (signupFlow === 'provider-signup') {
        getRedirectContext(session.user.id, signupFlow).then(async (context) => {
          const redirectUrl = await getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain(context, session.user.id)

          // SECURITY: Validate URL before redirect
          if (redirectUrl.startsWith('http://') || redirectUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
            if (validateRedirectUrl(redirectUrl)) {
              window.location.href = redirectUrl
            } else {
              // Security validation failed - fallback to path
              router.push('/onboarding?flow=provider-signup')
            }
          } else {
            // Path - use router
            router.push(redirectUrl)
          }
        })
        return
      }

      // Otherwise, determine user type and redirect accordingly
      getRedirectContext(session.user.id, signupFlow || null).then(async (context) => {
        const redirectUrl = await getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain(context, session.user.id)

        // SECURITY: Validate URL before redirect
        if (redirectUrl.startsWith('http://') || redirectUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
          if (validateRedirectUrl(redirectUrl)) {
            window.location.href = redirectUrl
          } else {
            router.push(getRedirectPath(context))
          }
        } else {
          router.push(redirectUrl)
        }
      })
    }
  }, [session, router, justSignedUp])

  // Don't render form if already signed in
  if (session) {
    return null
  }

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      toast({
        title: 'Password Mismatch',
        description: 'Passwords do not match. Please try again.',
        variant: 'destructive',
      })
      return
    }

    if (password.length < 8) {
      toast({
        title: 'Password Too Short',
        description: 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.',
        variant: 'destructive',
      })
      return
    }

    setLoading(true)

    try {
      await signUp.email(
        {
          email,
          password,
          name,
        },
        {
          onRequest: () => {
            setLoading(true)
          },
          onResponse: () => {
            setLoading(false)
          },
          onError: (ctx) => {
            // Check for duplicate email error
            const errorMessage = ctx.error.message || ''
            const errorStatus = ctx.error.status || 0
            const errorData = ctx.error.data || {}
            
            // Better Auth returns 422 for validation errors including duplicate emails
            // Check multiple indicators for duplicate email
            const isDuplicateEmail = 
              errorStatus === 422 ||
              errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('email') && 
              (errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('already') || 
               errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('exists') ||
               errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('unique') ||
               errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('taken') ||
               errorData?.email?.includes('already') ||
               errorData?.email?.includes('exists') ||
               errorData?.email?.includes('unique'))
            
            if (isDuplicateEmail) {
              toast({
                title: 'Email Already Registered',
                description: `The email address "${email}" is already registered. Please sign in instead or use a different email address.`,
                variant: 'destructive',
              })
            } else {
              toast({
                title: 'Sign Up Failed',
                description: errorMessage || 'Failed to create account. Please try again.',
                variant: 'destructive',
              })
            }
            setLoading(false)
          },
              onSuccess: async () => {
                setJustSignedUp(true) // Prevent useEffect from redirecting
                toast({
                  title: 'Account Created!',
                  description: 'Welcome to BukinPoint! Let\'s set up your business profile.',
                })
                
                // Refresh to get updated session, then check for subdomain redirect
                router.refresh()
                
                // Wait a bit for session to be available, then check for subdomain redirect
                setTimeout(async () => {
                  // Get fresh session after refresh
                  const currentSession = session
                  if (!currentSession?.user?.id) {
                    // Session not available yet, use fallback
                    router.push('/onboarding?flow=provider-signup')
                    return
                  }
                  
                  // Check for subdomain redirect
                  const context = await getRedirectContext(currentSession.user.id, 'provider-signup')
                  const redirectUrl = await getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain(
                    context,
                    currentSession.user.id
                  )

                  // SECURITY: Validate URL before redirect
                  if (redirectUrl.startsWith('http://') || redirectUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
                    if (validateRedirectUrl(redirectUrl)) {
                      window.location.href = redirectUrl
                    } else {
                      // Security validation failed - fallback to path
                      router.push('/onboarding?flow=provider-signup')
                    }
                  } else {
                    // Path - use router
                    router.push(redirectUrl)
                  }
                }, 300)
              },
        }
      )
    } catch (err) {
      toast({
        title: 'Error',
        description: 'An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.',
        variant: 'destructive',
      })
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Create Account</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>Enter your information to create an account</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="name" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Name
            </label>
            <Input
              id="name"
              type="text"
              placeholder="John Doe"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              required
              disabled={loading}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="email" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Email
            </label>
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
              disabled={loading}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="password" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Password
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Input
                id="password"
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                placeholder="••••••••"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                required
                disabled={loading}
                minLength={8}
                className="pr-10"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
                disabled={loading}
                aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              >
                {showPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-caption">Must be at least 8 characters</p>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="confirmPassword" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Confirm Password
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Input
                id="confirmPassword"
                type={showConfirmPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                placeholder="••••••••"
                value={confirmPassword}
                onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                required
                disabled={loading}
                className="pr-10"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowConfirmPassword(!showConfirmPassword)}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
                disabled={loading}
                aria-label={showConfirmPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              >
                {showConfirmPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="flex flex-col space-y-4">
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? 'Creating account...' : 'Sign Up'}
          </Button>
          <p className="text-center text-body-sm text-text-secondary">
            Already have an account?{' '}
            <Link href="/signin" className="text-link font-medium">
              Sign in
            </Link>
          </p>
        </CardFooter>
      </form>
    </Card>
  )
}

```

```typescriptreact
          onError: (ctx) => {
            // Check for duplicate email error
            const errorMessage = ctx.error.message || ''
            const errorStatus = ctx.error.status || 0
            const errorData = ctx.error.data || {}
            
            // Better Auth returns 422 for validation errors including duplicate emails

            const isDuplicateEmail = 
              errorStatus === 422 ||
              errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('email') && 
              (errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('already') ||

               errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('unique') ||

               errorData?.email?.includes('already') ||

            if (isDuplicateEmail) {

                variant: 'destructive',
              })
            }
            setLoading(false)
          },
              onSuccess: async () => {
                setJustSignedUp(true) // Prevent useEffect from redirecting
                toast({
                  title: 'Account Created!',
                  description: 'Welcome to BukinPoint! Let\'s set up your business profile.',
                })
                
                // Refresh to get updated session
                router.refresh()
                
                // Wait for session to be available (Better Auth updates it automatically)
                // Poll for session up to 2 seconds
                let attempts = 0

                  if (currentSession?.user?.id) {

                    const redirectUrl = await getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain(

                    if (redirectUrl.startsWith('http://') || redirectUrl.startsWith('https://')) {

                    }
                  } else if (attempts < maxAttempts) {

                    setTimeout(checkSession, 100)
                  } else {
                    // Timeout - use fallback
                    router.push('/onboarding?flow=provider-signup')
                  }
                }
                
                // Start checking for session
                setTimeout(checkSession, 100)
              },
        }

    } catch (err) {
```

Fixing the session closure issue by using a ref to track the latest session:


```typescriptreact
'use client'

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { signUp, useSession } from '@/lib/auth-client'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react'
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast'
import { getRedirectContext, type AuthFlow } from '@/lib/auth-redirect'
import { getRedirectPath, getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain, validateRedirectUrl } from '@/lib/auth-utils'

export function SignUpForm() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { data: session } = useSession()
  const { toast } = useToast()
  const [name, setName] = useState('')
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('')
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false)
  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [justSignedUp, setJustSignedUp] = useState(false)

  // Redirect if already signed in (use useEffect to avoid render-time navigation)
  // BUT: Don't redirect if we just signed up (let onSuccess handle it)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (session?.user?.id && !justSignedUp) {
      // Check if we're coming from a successful provider signup
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
      const signupFlow = urlParams.get('flow') as AuthFlow | null

      // If this is a provider signup flow, check for subdomain redirect
      if (signupFlow === 'provider-signup') {
        getRedirectContext(session.user.id, signupFlow).then(async (context) => {
          const redirectUrl = await getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain(context, session.user.id)

          // SECURITY: Validate URL before redirect
          if (redirectUrl.startsWith('http://') || redirectUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
            if (validateRedirectUrl(redirectUrl)) {
              window.location.href = redirectUrl
            } else {
              // Security validation failed - fallback to path
              router.push('/onboarding?flow=provider-signup')
            }
          } else {
            // Path - use router
            router.push(redirectUrl)
          }
        })
        return
      }

      // Otherwise, determine user type and redirect accordingly
      getRedirectContext(session.user.id, signupFlow || null).then(async (context) => {
        const redirectUrl = await getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain(context, session.user.id)

        // SECURITY: Validate URL before redirect
        if (redirectUrl.startsWith('http://') || redirectUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
          if (validateRedirectUrl(redirectUrl)) {
            window.location.href = redirectUrl
          } else {
            router.push(getRedirectPath(context))
          }
        } else {
          router.push(redirectUrl)
        }
      })
    }
  }, [session, router, justSignedUp])

  // Don't render form if already signed in
  if (session) {
    return null
  }

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      toast({
        title: 'Password Mismatch',
        description: 'Passwords do not match. Please try again.',
        variant: 'destructive',
      })
      return
    }

    if (password.length < 8) {
      toast({
        title: 'Password Too Short',
        description: 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.',
        variant: 'destructive',
      })
      return
    }

    setLoading(true)

    try {
      await signUp.email(
        {
          email,
          password,
          name,
        },
        {
          onRequest: () => {
            setLoading(true)
          },
          onResponse: () => {
            setLoading(false)
          },
          onError: (ctx) => {
            // Check for duplicate email error
            const errorMessage = ctx.error.message || ''
            const errorStatus = ctx.error.status || 0
            const errorData = ctx.error.data || {}
            
            // Better Auth returns 422 for validation errors including duplicate emails
            // Check multiple indicators for duplicate email
            const isDuplicateEmail = 
              errorStatus === 422 ||
              errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('email') && 
              (errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('already') || 
               errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('exists') ||
               errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('unique') ||
               errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('taken') ||
               errorData?.email?.includes('already') ||
               errorData?.email?.includes('exists') ||
               errorData?.email?.includes('unique'))
            
            if (isDuplicateEmail) {
              toast({
                title: 'Email Already Registered',
                description: `The email address "${email}" is already registered. Please sign in instead or use a different email address.`,
                variant: 'destructive',
              })
            } else {
              toast({
                title: 'Sign Up Failed',
                description: errorMessage || 'Failed to create account. Please try again.',
                variant: 'destructive',
              })
            }
            setLoading(false)
          },
              onSuccess: async () => {
                setJustSignedUp(true) // Prevent useEffect from redirecting
                toast({
                  title: 'Account Created!',
                  description: 'Welcome to BukinPoint! Let\'s set up your business profile.',
                })
                
                // Refresh to get updated session
                router.refresh()
                
                // Wait for session to be available (Better Auth updates it automatically)
                // Poll for session up to 2 seconds
                let attempts = 0
                const maxAttempts = 20
                const checkSession = async () => {
                  attempts++
                  const currentSession = session
                  
                  if (currentSession?.user?.id) {
                    // Session available, check for subdomain redirect
                    const context = await getRedirectContext(currentSession.user.id, 'provider-signup')
                    const redirectUrl = await getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain(
                      context,
                      currentSession.user.id
                    )

                    // SECURITY: Validate URL before redirect
                    if (redirectUrl.startsWith('http://') || redirectUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
                      if (validateRedirectUrl(redirectUrl)) {
                        window.location.href = redirectUrl
                      } else {
                        // Security validation failed - fallback to path
                        router.push('/onboarding?flow=provider-signup')
                      }
                    } else {
                      // Path - use router
                      router.push(redirectUrl)
                    }
                  } else if (attempts < maxAttempts) {
                    // Session not available yet, wait and try again
                    setTimeout(checkSession, 100)
                  } else {
                    // Timeout - use fallback
                    router.push('/onboarding?flow=provider-signup')
                  }
                }
                
                // Start checking for session
                setTimeout(checkSession, 100)
              },
        }
      )
    } catch (err) {
      toast({
        title: 'Error',
        description: 'An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.',
        variant: 'destructive',
      })
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Create Account</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>Enter your information to create an account</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="name" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Name
            </label>
            <Input
              id="name"
              type="text"
              placeholder="John Doe"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              required
              disabled={loading}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="email" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Email
            </label>
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
              disabled={loading}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="password" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Password
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Input
                id="password"
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                placeholder="••••••••"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                required
                disabled={loading}
                minLength={8}
                className="pr-10"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
                disabled={loading}
                aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              >
                {showPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-caption">Must be at least 8 characters</p>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="confirmPassword" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Confirm Password
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Input
                id="confirmPassword"
                type={showConfirmPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                placeholder="••••••••"
                value={confirmPassword}
                onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                required
                disabled={loading}
                className="pr-10"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowConfirmPassword(!showConfirmPassword)}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
                disabled={loading}
                aria-label={showConfirmPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              >
                {showConfirmPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="flex flex-col space-y-4">
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? 'Creating account...' : 'Sign Up'}
          </Button>
          <p className="text-center text-body-sm text-text-secondary">
            Already have an account?{' '}
            <Link href="/signin" className="text-link font-medium">
              Sign in

      </form>
```

```typescriptreact
              <Input
                id="confirmPassword"

                required
                disabled={loading}
                className="pr-10"

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowConfirmPassword(!showConfirmPassword)}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"

                aria-label={showConfirmPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              >
                {showConfirmPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>

        <CardFooter className="flex flex-col space-y-4">
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? 'Creating account...' : 'Sign Up'}

            Already have an account?{' '}
            <Link href="/signin" className="text-link font-medium">

        </CardFooter>
```

```typescriptreact
'use client'

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { signUp, useSession } from '@/lib/auth-client'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react'
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast'
import { getRedirectContext, type AuthFlow } from '@/lib/auth-redirect'
import { getRedirectPath, getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain, validateRedirectUrl } from '@/lib/auth-utils'

export function SignUpForm() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { data: session } = useSession()
  const { toast } = useToast()
  const [name, setName] = useState('')
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('')
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false)
  const [showConfirmPassword, setShowConfirmPassword] = useState(false)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [justSignedUp, setJustSignedUp] = useState(false)
  const sessionRef = useRef(session)
  
  // Keep session ref updated
  useEffect(() => {
    sessionRef.current = session
  }, [session])

  // Redirect if already signed in (use useEffect to avoid render-time navigation)
  // BUT: Don't redirect if we just signed up (let onSuccess handle it)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (session?.user?.id && !justSignedUp) {
      // Check if we're coming from a successful provider signup
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
      const signupFlow = urlParams.get('flow') as AuthFlow | null

      // If this is a provider signup flow, check for subdomain redirect
      if (signupFlow === 'provider-signup') {
        getRedirectContext(session.user.id, signupFlow).then(async (context) => {
          const redirectUrl = await getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain(context, session.user.id)

          // SECURITY: Validate URL before redirect
          if (redirectUrl.startsWith('http://') || redirectUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
            if (validateRedirectUrl(redirectUrl)) {
              window.location.href = redirectUrl
            } else {
              // Security validation failed - fallback to path
              router.push('/onboarding?flow=provider-signup')
            }
          } else {
            // Path - use router
            router.push(redirectUrl)
          }
        })
        return
      }

      // Otherwise, determine user type and redirect accordingly
      getRedirectContext(session.user.id, signupFlow || null).then(async (context) => {
        const redirectUrl = await getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain(context, session.user.id)

        // SECURITY: Validate URL before redirect
        if (redirectUrl.startsWith('http://') || redirectUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
          if (validateRedirectUrl(redirectUrl)) {
            window.location.href = redirectUrl
          } else {
            router.push(getRedirectPath(context))
          }
        } else {
          router.push(redirectUrl)
        }
      })
    }
  }, [session, router, justSignedUp])

  // Don't render form if already signed in
  if (session) {
    return null
  }

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      toast({
        title: 'Password Mismatch',
        description: 'Passwords do not match. Please try again.',
        variant: 'destructive',
      })
      return
    }

    if (password.length < 8) {
      toast({
        title: 'Password Too Short',
        description: 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.',
        variant: 'destructive',
      })
      return
    }

    setLoading(true)

    try {
      await signUp.email(
        {
          email,
          password,
          name,
        },
        {
          onRequest: () => {
            setLoading(true)
          },
          onResponse: () => {
            setLoading(false)
          },
          onError: (ctx) => {
            // Check for duplicate email error
            const errorMessage = ctx.error.message || ''
            const errorStatus = ctx.error.status || 0
            const errorData = ctx.error.data || {}
            
            // Better Auth returns 422 for validation errors including duplicate emails
            // Check multiple indicators for duplicate email
            const isDuplicateEmail = 
              errorStatus === 422 ||
              errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('email') && 
              (errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('already') || 
               errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('exists') ||
               errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('unique') ||
               errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('taken') ||
               errorData?.email?.includes('already') ||
               errorData?.email?.includes('exists') ||
               errorData?.email?.includes('unique'))
            
            if (isDuplicateEmail) {
              toast({
                title: 'Email Already Registered',
                description: `The email address "${email}" is already registered. Please sign in instead or use a different email address.`,
                variant: 'destructive',
              })
            } else {
              toast({
                title: 'Sign Up Failed',
                description: errorMessage || 'Failed to create account. Please try again.',
                variant: 'destructive',
              })
            }
            setLoading(false)
          },
              onSuccess: async () => {
                setJustSignedUp(true) // Prevent useEffect from redirecting
                toast({
                  title: 'Account Created!',
                  description: 'Welcome to BukinPoint! Let\'s set up your business profile.',
                })
                
                // Refresh to get updated session
                router.refresh()
                
                // Wait for session to be available (Better Auth updates it automatically)
                // Poll for session up to 2 seconds
                let attempts = 0
                const maxAttempts = 20
                const checkSession = async () => {
                  attempts++
                  // Use ref to get latest session value
                  const currentSession = sessionRef.current
                  
                  if (currentSession?.user?.id) {
                    // Session available, check for subdomain redirect
                    const context = await getRedirectContext(currentSession.user.id, 'provider-signup')
                    const redirectUrl = await getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain(
                      context,
                      currentSession.user.id
                    )

                    // SECURITY: Validate URL before redirect
                    if (redirectUrl.startsWith('http://') || redirectUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
                      if (validateRedirectUrl(redirectUrl)) {
                        window.location.href = redirectUrl
                      } else {
                        // Security validation failed - fallback to path
                        router.push('/onboarding?flow=provider-signup')
                      }
                    } else {
                      // Path - use router
                      router.push(redirectUrl)
                    }
                  } else if (attempts < maxAttempts) {
                    // Session not available yet, wait and try again
                    setTimeout(checkSession, 100)
                  } else {
                    // Timeout - use fallback
                    router.push('/onboarding?flow=provider-signup')
                  }
                }
                
                // Start checking for session
                setTimeout(checkSession, 100)
              },
        }
      )
    } catch (err) {
      toast({
        title: 'Error',
        description: 'An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.',
        variant: 'destructive',
      })
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Create Account</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>Enter your information to create an account</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="name" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Name
            </label>
            <Input
              id="name"
              type="text"
              placeholder="John Doe"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              required
              disabled={loading}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="email" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Email
            </label>
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
              disabled={loading}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="password" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Password
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Input
                id="password"
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                placeholder="••••••••"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                required
                disabled={loading}
                minLength={8}
                className="pr-10"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
                disabled={loading}
                aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              >
                {showPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-caption">Must be at least 8 characters</p>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="confirmPassword" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Confirm Password
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Input
                id="confirmPassword"
                type={showConfirmPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                placeholder="••••••••"
                value={confirmPassword}
                onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                required
                disabled={loading}
                className="pr-10"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowConfirmPassword(!showConfirmPassword)}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
                disabled={loading}
                aria-label={showConfirmPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              >
                {showConfirmPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="flex flex-col space-y-4">
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? 'Creating account...' : 'Sign Up'}
          </Button>
          <p className="text-center text-body-sm text-text-secondary">
            Already have an account?{' '}
            <Link href="/signin" className="text-link font-medium">
              Sign in
            </Link>
          </p>
        </CardFooter>
      </form>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

## Implementation complete

### Phase 1: Server-side security functions
- Added `getProviderSubdomain()` with ownership verification
- Added `getStaffProviderSubdomain()` with staff-provider relationship verification
- Added `getSecureSubdomainRedirect()` with:
  - Subdomain format validation (regex)
  - Reserved subdomain checking
  - Database ownership verification
  - Whitelist validation (only trusted domains)

### Phase 2: Client-side security utilities
- Added `isMainDomain()` to detect main domain vs subdomain
- Added `validateRedirectUrl()` with:
  - Whitelist validation (regex patterns)
  - HTTPS enforcement in production
  - Defense-in-depth validation
- Added `getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain()` wrapper function

### Phase 3: Updated auth components
- Updated `signin-form.tsx` to use secure subdomain redirect
- Updated `signup-form.tsx` to use secure subdomain redirect (with session ref fix)
- Updated `staff-signup-form.tsx` to use secure subdomain redirect

### Phase 4: Production security hardening
- Added HTTPS enforcement in `middleware.ts` for production
- Documented secure cookie configuration in `auth.ts` (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite)
- Updated `trustedOrigins` to include production domains

### Phase 5: Environment configuration
- Updated `ENV_SETUP.md` with production domain configuration notes

## Security features implemented

- Server-side ownership verification
- Whitelist validation of redirect URLs
- Subdomain format validation (regex: `^[a-z0-9-]{1,63}$`)
- Reserved subdomain checking
- HTTPS enforcement in production
- Client-side defense-in-depth validation
- Database verification of subdomain existence
- Active provider status checking
- Staff member provider relationship verification

## How it works

1. User signs up/logs in on main domain (`bukinpoint.test:3000` or `bukinpoint.com`)
2. System detects main domain using `isMainDomain()`
3. Server-side function fetches user's subdomain with ownership verification
4. Server builds secure redirect URL with whitelist validation
5. Client-side validates URL again (defense-in-depth)
6. If valid, redirects to subdomain (e.g., `thank-god.bukinpoint.test:3000/dashboard`)
7. Session cookie (`.bukinpoint.test` or `.bukinpoint.com`) persists across subdomains

## Production readiness

- Works automatically in production (uses `bukinpoint.com` domain)
- HTTPS enforced via middleware
- Secure cookies configured (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite)
- Trusted origins include production wildcard subdomains

All code changes are complete and linting passes. The implementation follows OWASP security best practices and industry standards for subdomain redirects.

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  // SECURITY: Enforce HTTPS in production
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    const protocol = request.nextUrl.protocol
    if (protocol !== 'https:') {
      // Redirect to HTTPS
      const httpsUrl = request.nextUrl.clone()
      httpsUrl.protocol = 'https:'
      return NextResponse.redirect(httpsUrl)
    }
  }

  const url = request.nextUrl.clone()
  const hostname = request.headers.get('host') || ''

  // Extract subdomain from hostname
  // Examples:
  // - migdala.bukinpoint.com -> migdala
  // - migdala.bukinpoint.local:3000 -> migdala
  // - localhost:3000 -> skip
  const parts = hostname.split('.')
  let subdomain = ''

  // Handle different hostname formats
  if (hostname.includes('localhost') || hostname.includes('127.0.0.1')) {
    // Skip localhost - no subdomain routing needed
    return NextResponse.next()
  }

  // Handle .test and .localhost domains for development
  if (hostname.includes('.test') || hostname.includes('.localhost')) {
    // Extract subdomain from .test or .localhost domain
    // thank-god.bukinpoint.test:3000 -> thank-god
    // thank-god.bukinpoint.localhost:3000 -> thank-god
    // bukinpoint.test:3000 -> skip (main domain)
    // bukinpoint.localhost:3000 -> skip (main domain)
    const domainParts = hostname.split('.')
    const isTest = domainParts.includes('test')
    const isLocalhost = domainParts.includes('localhost')

    if ((isTest || isLocalhost) && domainParts.length >= 3) {
      // Has subdomain: subdomain.bukinpoint.test or subdomain.bukinpoint.localhost
      subdomain = domainParts[0].toLowerCase()
    } else if ((isTest || isLocalhost) && domainParts.length === 2) {
      // Main domain: bukinpoint.test or bukinpoint.localhost (no subdomain)
      return NextResponse.next()
    } else {
      // Invalid format, skip
      return NextResponse.next()
    }
  } else {
    // Extract subdomain (first part before domain) for production
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
      subdomain = parts[0].toLowerCase()
    }
  }

  // Skip main domains and reserved subdomains
  const mainDomains = ['www', 'app', 'api', 'admin']
  if (mainDomains.includes(subdomain) || !subdomain) {
    return NextResponse.next()
  }

  // Check if subdomain exists in database via API route
  // This avoids using Prisma directly in Edge runtime
  try {
    // Construct API URL - use request URL origin to handle both dev and prod
    const origin = request.nextUrl.origin
    const lookupUrl = new URL('/api/subdomain-lookup', origin)
    lookupUrl.searchParams.set('subdomain', subdomain)

    const response = await fetch(lookupUrl.toString(), {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      // Use cache to avoid repeated lookups for same subdomain
      cache: 'no-store',
    })

    if (!response.ok) {
      // On error, continue with normal request
      return NextResponse.next()
    }

    const data = await response.json()

    if (!data.provider) {
      // Provider not found or inactive - redirect to main domain
      const mainDomain = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || origin
      return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(mainDomain))
    }

    // Rewrite to booking page with providerId
    // For root path or /book, rewrite to /book/[providerId]
    if (url.pathname === '/' || url.pathname === '/book') {
      url.pathname = `/book/${data.provider.id}`
      return NextResponse.rewrite(url)
    }

    // SECURITY: Don't allow auth pages on subdomains - redirect to main domain
    // This prevents confusion and ensures auth happens on main domain
    const authPaths = ['/signin', '/signup', '/signup/provider', '/signup/staff', '/signup/customer']
    if (authPaths.some((path) => url.pathname.startsWith(path))) {
      const mainDomain = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || origin
      const redirectUrl = new URL(url.pathname + url.search, mainDomain)
      return NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl)
    }

    // For other paths, add provider context via headers
    const requestHeaders = new Headers(request.headers)
    requestHeaders.set('x-provider-id', data.provider.id)
    requestHeaders.set('x-subdomain', subdomain)

    return NextResponse.next({
      request: {
        headers: requestHeaders,
      },
    })
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error in middleware subdomain lookup:', error)
    // On error, continue with normal request
    return NextResponse.next()
  }
}

export const config = {
  matcher: [
    /*
     * Match all request paths except for the ones starting with:
     * - api (API routes)
     * - _next/static (static files)
     * - _next/image (image optimization files)
     * - favicon.ico (favicon file)
     */
    '/((?!api|_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico).*)',
  ],
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Centralized authentication redirect logic (Server Actions)
 * Handles post-signup and post-signin redirects based on user type and flow context
 */

'use server'

import { prisma } from './db'

export type UserType = 'provider' | 'staff' | 'customer' | null
export type AuthFlow = 'provider-signup' | 'staff-signup' | 'customer-signup' | 'signin' | null

export interface RedirectContext {
  userType: UserType
  flow?: AuthFlow
  hasProvider?: boolean
  hasStaffMember?: boolean
  needsOnboarding?: boolean
}

/**
 * Determine user type from database
 */
export async function getUserType(userId: string): Promise<UserType> {
  try {
    // Check if user is a provider
    const provider = await prisma.provider.findUnique({
      where: { userId },
    })

    if (provider) {
      return 'provider'
    }

    // Check if user is staff
    const staffMember = await prisma.staffMember.findFirst({
      where: { userId },
      select: { id: true },
    })

    if (staffMember) {
      return 'staff'
    }

    // Otherwise, they're a customer
    return 'customer'
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error in getUserType:', error)
    return null
  }
}

/**
 * Get redirect context for a user
 */
export async function getRedirectContext(
  userId: string,
  flow?: AuthFlow
): Promise<RedirectContext> {
  const userType = await getUserType(userId)

  // Check if user needs onboarding (provider signup but no provider record)
  const needsOnboarding =
    flow === 'provider-signup' && userType === 'customer' && !(await hasProvider(userId))

  return {
    userType,
    flow,
    hasProvider: userType === 'provider',
    hasStaffMember: userType === 'staff',
    needsOnboarding,
  }
}

/**
 * Check if user has provider record
 */
async function hasProvider(userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const provider = await prisma.provider.findUnique({
    where: { userId },
  })
  return !!provider
}

/**
 * Get provider subdomain with ownership verification
 * SECURITY: Verifies subdomain belongs to authenticated user
 */
export async function getProviderSubdomain(userId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const provider = await prisma.provider.findUnique({
      where: { userId },
      select: { subdomain: true, status: true },
    })

    // Only return if provider exists and is active
    if (!provider || provider.status !== 'ACTIVE' || !provider.subdomain) {
      return null
    }

    return provider.subdomain
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error getting provider subdomain:', error)
    return null
  }
}

/**
 * Get staff member's provider subdomain with ownership verification
 * SECURITY: Verifies staff member belongs to provider
 */
export async function getStaffProviderSubdomain(userId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const staffMember = await prisma.staffMember.findFirst({
      where: { userId },
      include: {
        provider: {
          select: { subdomain: true, status: true },
        },
      },
    })

    if (
      !staffMember?.provider ||
      staffMember.provider.status !== 'ACTIVE' ||
      !staffMember.provider.subdomain
    ) {
      return null
    }

    return staffMember.provider.subdomain
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error getting staff provider subdomain:', error)
    return null
  }
}

/**
 * Validate and build secure subdomain redirect URL
 * SECURITY: Whitelist validation - only allows trusted domains
 */
export async function getSecureSubdomainRedirect(
  userId: string,
  subdomain: string | null,
  path: string
): Promise<string | null> {
  // Must have subdomain
  if (!subdomain) {
    return null
  }

  // SECURITY: Validate subdomain format (prevent injection)
  if (!/^[a-z0-9-]{1,63}$/.test(subdomain)) {
    console.error('Invalid subdomain format:', subdomain)
    return null
  }

  // SECURITY: Check reserved subdomains
  const { isReservedSubdomain } = await import('@/lib/subdomain-utils')
  if (isReservedSubdomain(subdomain)) {
    console.error('Reserved subdomain:', subdomain)
    return null
  }

  // SECURITY: Verify subdomain exists in database and belongs to user
  // Add timeout and error handling for database queries
  try {
    const provider = await Promise.race([
      prisma.provider.findFirst({
        where: {
          subdomain,
          OR: [
            { userId }, // Provider owns it
            { staff: { some: { userId } } }, // Staff member of provider
          ],
        },
        select: { status: true },
      }),
      new Promise((_, reject) =>
        setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Database query timeout')), 5000)
      ),
    ]) as { status: string } | null

    if (!provider || provider.status !== 'ACTIVE') {
      console.error('Subdomain not found or inactive for user:', subdomain, userId)
      return null
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Database error in getSecureSubdomainRedirect:', error)
    // On database error, fail securely - don't redirect
    return null
  }

  // SECURITY: Whitelist validation - only allow trusted base domains
  const allowedDomains =
    process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
      ? ['bukinpoint.com']
      : ['bukinpoint.test', 'bukinpoint.localhost']

  // Build URL (will be validated client-side too)
  const baseDomain = allowedDomains[0] // Use first allowed domain
  const protocol = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 'https' : 'http'
  const port = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? ':3000' : ''

  return `${protocol}://${subdomain}.${baseDomain}${port}${path}`
}
```

```typescriptreact
'use client'

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { signIn, useSession } from '@/lib/auth-client'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react'
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast'
import { acceptInvitationAfterSignup, checkAndAcceptPendingInvitations } from '@/actions/staff-invitations'
import { getRedirectContext } from '@/lib/auth-redirect'
import { getRedirectPath, getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain, validateRedirectUrl } from '@/lib/auth-utils'

interface SignInFormProps {
  initialEmail?: string
  invitationToken?: string
}

export function SignInForm({ initialEmail, invitationToken }: SignInFormProps) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { data: session } = useSession()
  const { toast } = useToast()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(initialEmail || '')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  // Redirect if already signed in (use useEffect to avoid render-time navigation)
  // SECURITY: Only redirect if we're on the main domain (not already on a subdomain)
  useEffect(() => {
    // Don't redirect if we're already on a subdomain (let subdomain handle its own auth)
    const hostname = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.hostname : ''
    const isOnSubdomain = hostname.includes('.') && 
      !hostname.startsWith('localhost') && 
      !hostname.startsWith('127.0.0.1') &&
      !['bukinpoint.test', 'bukinpoint.localhost', 'bukinpoint.com'].includes(hostname)
    
    if (isOnSubdomain) {
      // Already on subdomain, don't redirect
      return
    }
    
    if (session?.user?.id && session?.user?.email) {
      // If there's an invitation token, handle it first
      if (invitationToken) {
        // Don't redirect yet - let the accept-invitation page handle it
        return
      }
      
      // Check for pending invitations and accept them automatically
      checkAndAcceptPendingInvitations(session.user.id, session.user.email)
        .then(() => {
          // Wait a bit for staff member to be created, then check user type
          setTimeout(async () => {
            const context = await getRedirectContext(session.user.id, 'signin')
            const redirectUrl = await getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain(context, session.user.id)

            // SECURITY: Validate URL before redirect
            if (redirectUrl.startsWith('http://') || redirectUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
              // Full URL - validate and use window.location
              if (validateRedirectUrl(redirectUrl)) {
                window.location.href = redirectUrl
              } else {
                // Security validation failed - fallback to path
                router.push(getRedirectPath(context))
              }
            } else {
              // Path - use router
              router.push(redirectUrl)
            }
          }, 500)
        })
        .catch(async (err) => {
          // If invitation check fails, still proceed with normal redirect
          console.error('Error checking pending invitations:', err)
          const context = await getRedirectContext(session.user.id, 'signin')
          const redirectUrl = await getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain(context, session.user.id)

          // SECURITY: Validate URL before redirect
          if (redirectUrl.startsWith('http://') || redirectUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
            if (validateRedirectUrl(redirectUrl)) {
              window.location.href = redirectUrl
            } else {
              router.push(getRedirectPath(context))
            }
          } else {
            router.push(redirectUrl)
          }
        })
    }
  }, [session, router, invitationToken])

  // Don't render form if already signed in
  if (session) {
    return null
  }

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)

    try {
      await signIn.email(
        {
          email,
          password,
        },
        {
          onRequest: () => {
            setLoading(true)
          },
          onResponse: () => {
            setLoading(false)
          },
          onError: (ctx) => {
            const errorMessage = ctx.error.message || 'Failed to sign in'
            const isInvalidCredentials = 
              errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('invalid') ||
              errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('password') ||
              errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('credentials') ||
              ctx.error.status === 401
            
            if (isInvalidCredentials) {
              toast({
                title: 'Invalid Credentials',
                description: 'The email or password you entered is incorrect. Please try again.',
                variant: 'destructive',
              })
            } else {
              toast({
                title: 'Sign In Failed',
                description: errorMessage,
                variant: 'destructive',
              })
            }
            setLoading(false)
          },
          onSuccess: async () => {
            // If there's an invitation token, redirect to accept it
            if (invitationToken) {
              router.push(`/signin/accept-invitation?token=${invitationToken}`)
              return
            }

            toast({
              title: 'Welcome Back!',
              description: 'You have been successfully signed in.',
            })
            
            // Refresh - the useEffect will handle checking invitations and redirecting
            router.refresh()
          },
        }
      )
    } catch (err) {
      toast({
        title: 'Error',
        description: 'An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.',
        variant: 'destructive',
      })
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Sign In</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>Enter your credentials to access your account</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="email" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Email
            </label>
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
              disabled={loading}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="password" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Password
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Input
                id="password"
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                placeholder="••••••••"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                required
                disabled={loading}
                className="pr-10"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
                disabled={loading}
                aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              >
                {showPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="flex flex-col space-y-4">
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? 'Signing in...' : 'Sign In'}
          </Button>
          <p className="text-center text-body-sm text-text-secondary">
            Don't have an account?{' '}
            <Link href="/signup" className="text-link font-medium">
              Sign up
            </Link>
          </p>
        </CardFooter>
      </form>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Centralized authentication redirect logic (Server Actions)
 * Handles post-signup and post-signin redirects based on user type and flow context
 */

'use server'

import { prisma } from './db'

export type UserType = 'provider' | 'staff' | 'customer' | null
export type AuthFlow = 'provider-signup' | 'staff-signup' | 'customer-signup' | 'signin' | null

export interface RedirectContext {
  userType: UserType
  flow?: AuthFlow
  hasProvider?: boolean
  hasStaffMember?: boolean
  needsOnboarding?: boolean
}

/**
 * Determine user type from database
 */
export async function getUserType(userId: string): Promise<UserType> {
  try {
    // Check if user is a provider
    const provider = await prisma.provider.findUnique({
      where: { userId },
    })

    if (provider) {
      return 'provider'
    }

    // Check if user is staff
    const staffMember = await prisma.staffMember.findFirst({
      where: { userId },
      select: { id: true },
    })

    if (staffMember) {
      return 'staff'
    }

    // Otherwise, they're a customer
    return 'customer'
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error in getUserType:', error)
    return null
  }
}

/**
 * Get redirect context for a user
 */
export async function getRedirectContext(
  userId: string,
  flow?: AuthFlow
): Promise<RedirectContext> {
  const userType = await getUserType(userId)

  // Check if user needs onboarding (provider signup but no provider record)
  const needsOnboarding =
    flow === 'provider-signup' && userType === 'customer' && !(await hasProvider(userId))

  return {
    userType,
    flow,
    hasProvider: userType === 'provider',
    hasStaffMember: userType === 'staff',
    needsOnboarding,
  }
}

/**
 * Check if user has provider record
 */
async function hasProvider(userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const provider = await prisma.provider.findUnique({
    where: { userId },
  })
  return !!provider
}

/**
 * Get provider subdomain with ownership verification
 * SECURITY: Verifies subdomain belongs to authenticated user
 */
export async function getProviderSubdomain(userId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const provider = await prisma.provider.findUnique({
      where: { userId },
      select: { subdomain: true, status: true },
    })

    // Only return if provider exists and is active
    if (!provider || provider.status !== 'ACTIVE' || !provider.subdomain) {
      return null
    }

    return provider.subdomain
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error getting provider subdomain:', error)
    return null
  }
}

/**
 * Get staff member's provider subdomain with ownership verification
 * SECURITY: Verifies staff member belongs to provider
 */
export async function getStaffProviderSubdomain(userId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const staffMember = await prisma.staffMember.findFirst({
      where: { userId },
      include: {
        provider: {
          select: { subdomain: true, status: true },
        },
      },
    })

    if (
      !staffMember?.provider ||
      staffMember.provider.status !== 'ACTIVE' ||
      !staffMember.provider.subdomain
    ) {
      return null
    }

    return staffMember.provider.subdomain
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error getting staff provider subdomain:', error)
    return null
  }
}

/**
 * Validate and build secure subdomain redirect URL
 * SECURITY: Whitelist validation - only allows trusted domains
 */
export async function getSecureSubdomainRedirect(
  userId: string,
  subdomain: string | null,
  path: string
): Promise<string | null> {
  // Must have subdomain
  if (!subdomain) {
    return null
  }

  // SECURITY: Validate subdomain format (prevent injection)
  if (!/^[a-z0-9-]{1,63}$/.test(subdomain)) {
    console.error('Invalid subdomain format:', subdomain)
    return null
  }

  // SECURITY: Check reserved subdomains
  const { isReservedSubdomain } = await import('@/lib/subdomain-utils')
  if (isReservedSubdomain(subdomain)) {
    console.error('Reserved subdomain:', subdomain)
    return null
  }

  // SECURITY: Verify subdomain exists in database and belongs to user
  // Add timeout and error handling for database queries
  let provider: { status: string } | null = null
  try {
    provider = await prisma.provider.findFirst({
      where: {
        subdomain,
        OR: [
          { userId }, // Provider owns it
          { staff: { some: { userId } } }, // Staff member of provider
        ],
      },
      select: { status: true },
    })
  } catch (error: any) {
    // Handle database errors gracefully
    if (error?.code === 'ETIMEDOUT' || error?.code === 'P1008') {
      console.error('Database connection timeout in getSecureSubdomainRedirect:', error)
    } else {
      console.error('Database error in getSecureSubdomainRedirect:', error)
    }
    // On database error, fail securely - don't redirect
    return null
  }

  if (!provider || provider.status !== 'ACTIVE') {
    console.error('Subdomain not found or inactive for user:', subdomain, userId)
    return null
  }

  // SECURITY: Whitelist validation - only allow trusted base domains
  const allowedDomains =
    process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'
      ? ['bukinpoint.com']
      : ['bukinpoint.test', 'bukinpoint.localhost']

  // Build URL (will be validated client-side too)
  const baseDomain = allowedDomains[0] // Use first allowed domain
  const protocol = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 'https' : 'http'
  const port = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? ':3000' : ''

  return `${protocol}://${subdomain}.${baseDomain}${port}${path}`
}
```

```typescript
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'
import { Pool } from 'pg'
import { PrismaPg } from '@prisma/adapter-pg'

const globalForPrisma = globalThis as unknown as {
  prisma: PrismaClient | undefined
}

const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL

if (!connectionString) {
  throw new Error(
    'DATABASE_URL environment variable is not set. Please set it in your .env file. See .env.example for reference.'
  )
}

const pool = new Pool({
  connectionString,
  // Add connection pool settings to prevent timeouts
  max: 20, // Maximum number of clients in the pool
  idleTimeoutMillis: 30000, // Close idle clients after 30 seconds
  connectionTimeoutMillis: 10000, // Return an error after 10 seconds if connection could not be established
})
const adapter = new PrismaPg(pool)

export const prisma =
  globalForPrisma.prisma ??
  new PrismaClient({
    adapter,
    log: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? ['query', 'error', 'warn'] : ['error'],
  })

if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') globalForPrisma.prisma = prisma
```

Fixed both issues:

## Issue 1: Auto-redirect to subdomain signin

**Problem**: Visiting the main domain signin page redirected to the subdomain signin page, even when not signed in.

**Root cause**: The middleware allowed auth pages on subdomains, and the signin form redirected based on session cookies.

**Fix**:
1. Middleware now redirects auth pages (`/signin`, `/signup`, etc.) from subdomains back to the main domain.
2. Signin form only redirects if on the main domain (not already on a subdomain).

## Issue 2: Prisma timeout error

**Problem**: Database query timeout when signing in from the root domain.

**Root cause**: Database connection pool issues or slow queries.

**Fix**:
1. Added error handling in `getSecureSubdomainRedirect` to catch timeout errors gracefully.
2. Improved connection pool settings in `db.ts`:
   - `max: 20` - Maximum connections
   - `idleTimeoutMillis: 30000` - Close idle connections after 30s
   - `connectionTimeoutMillis: 10000` - Timeout after 10s if connection can't be established

## Changes made

1. `src/middleware.ts`: Added redirect for auth pages on subdomains to main domain
2. `src/components/auth/signin-form.tsx`: Added check to only redirect if on main domain
3. `src/lib/auth-redirect.ts`: Added timeout error handling for database queries
4. `src/lib/db.ts`: Added connection pool configuration to prevent timeouts

## Testing

1. Visit `bukinpoint.test:3000/signin` — should stay on main domain
2. Visit `thank-god.bukinpoint.test:3000/signin` — should redirect to `bukinpoint.test:3000/signin`
3. Sign in from main domain — should not timeout and should redirect to subdomain after successful login

The timeout error should be resolved with the improved connection pool settings. If it persists, it may indicate a database connectivity issue that needs investigation.

Fixing both issues: ensuring the redirect uses `/dashboard` (not `/signin`), and redirecting to `/dashboard` when signed in on a subdomain.


```typescriptreact
'use client'

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { signIn, useSession } from '@/lib/auth-client'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react'
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast'
import { acceptInvitationAfterSignup, checkAndAcceptPendingInvitations } from '@/actions/staff-invitations'
import { getRedirectContext } from '@/lib/auth-redirect'
import { getRedirectPath, getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain, validateRedirectUrl } from '@/lib/auth-utils'

interface SignInFormProps {
  initialEmail?: string
  invitationToken?: string
}

export function SignInForm({ initialEmail, invitationToken }: SignInFormProps) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const { data: session } = useSession()
  const { toast } = useToast()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(initialEmail || '')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  // Redirect if already signed in (use useEffect to avoid render-time navigation)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session?.user?.id || !session?.user?.email) {
      return
    }

    // Check if we're on a subdomain
    const hostname = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.hostname : ''
    const isOnSubdomain = hostname.includes('.') && 
      !hostname.startsWith('localhost') && 
      !hostname.startsWith('127.0.0.1') &&
      !['bukinpoint.test', 'bukinpoint.localhost', 'bukinpoint.com'].includes(hostname)
    
    if (isOnSubdomain) {
      // Already on subdomain and signed in - redirect to dashboard on this subdomain
      // Don't redirect to main domain, stay on subdomain
      router.push('/dashboard')
      return
    }
    
    // On main domain - check for subdomain redirect
    // If there's an invitation token, handle it first
    if (invitationToken) {
      // Don't redirect yet - let the accept-invitation page handle it
      return
    }
    
    // Check for pending invitations and accept them automatically
    checkAndAcceptPendingInvitations(session.user.id, session.user.email)
      .then(() => {
        // Wait a bit for staff member to be created, then check user type
        setTimeout(async () => {
          const context = await getRedirectContext(session.user.id, 'signin')
          const redirectUrl = await getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain(context, session.user.id)

          // SECURITY: Validate URL before redirect
          // Ensure we're redirecting to /dashboard, not /signin
          if (redirectUrl.startsWith('http://') || redirectUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
            // Full URL - validate and use window.location
            if (validateRedirectUrl(redirectUrl)) {
              // Double-check the URL doesn't end with /signin
              const urlObj = new URL(redirectUrl)
              if (urlObj.pathname === '/signin') {
                // Fix: redirect to dashboard instead
                urlObj.pathname = '/dashboard'
                window.location.href = urlObj.toString()
              } else {
                window.location.href = redirectUrl
              }
            } else {
              // Security validation failed - fallback to path
              router.push(getRedirectPath(context))
            }
          } else {
            // Path - use router
            router.push(redirectUrl)
          }
        }, 500)
      })
      .catch(async (err) => {
        // If invitation check fails, still proceed with normal redirect
        console.error('Error checking pending invitations:', err)
        const context = await getRedirectContext(session.user.id, 'signin')
        const redirectUrl = await getRedirectUrlWithSubdomain(context, session.user.id)

        // SECURITY: Validate URL before redirect
        if (redirectUrl.startsWith('http://') || redirectUrl.startsWith('https://')) {
          if (validateRedirectUrl(redirectUrl)) {
            // Double-check the URL doesn't end with /signin
            const urlObj = new URL(redirectUrl)
            if (urlObj.pathname === '/signin') {
              urlObj.pathname = '/dashboard'
              window.location.href = urlObj.toString()
            } else {
              window.location.href = redirectUrl
            }
          } else {
            router.push(getRedirectPath(context))
          }
        } else {
          router.push(redirectUrl)
        }
      })
  }, [session, router, invitationToken])

  // Don't render form if already signed in
  if (session) {
    return null
  }

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)

    try {
      await signIn.email(
        {
          email,
          password,
        },
        {
          onRequest: () => {
            setLoading(true)
          },
          onResponse: () => {
            setLoading(false)
          },
          onError: (ctx) => {
            const errorMessage = ctx.error.message || 'Failed to sign in'
            const isInvalidCredentials = 
              errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('invalid') ||
              errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('password') ||
              errorMessage.toLowerCase().includes('credentials') ||
              ctx.error.status === 401
            
            if (isInvalidCredentials) {
              toast({
                title: 'Invalid Credentials',
                description: 'The email or password you entered is incorrect. Please try again.',
                variant: 'destructive',
              })
            } else {
              toast({
                title: 'Sign In Failed',
                description: errorMessage,
                variant: 'destructive',
              })
            }
            setLoading(false)
          },
          onSuccess: async () => {
            // If there's an invitation token, redirect to accept it
            if (invitationToken) {
              router.push(`/signin/accept-invitation?token=${invitationToken}`)
              return
            }

            toast({
              title: 'Welcome Back!',
              description: 'You have been successfully signed in.',
            })
            
            // Refresh - the useEffect will handle checking invitations and redirecting
            router.refresh()
          },
        }
      )
    } catch (err) {
      toast({
        title: 'Error',
        description: 'An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.',
        variant: 'destructive',
      })
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Sign In</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>Enter your credentials to access your account</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="email" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Email
            </label>
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
              disabled={loading}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="password" className="text-body-sm font-medium">
              Password
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Input
                id="password"
                type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                placeholder="••••••••"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                required
                disabled={loading}
                className="pr-10"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary"
                disabled={loading}
                aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
              >
                {showPassword ? (
                  <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" />
                ) : (
                  <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
        <CardFooter className="flex flex-col space-y-4">
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full" disabled={loading}>
            {loading ? 'Signing in...' : 'Sign In'}
          </Button>
          <p className="text-center text-body-sm text-text-secondary">
            Don't have an account?{' '}
            <Link href="/signup" className="text-link font-medium">
              Sign up
            </Link>
          </p>
        </CardFooter>
      </form>
    </Card>
  )
}
```
